messages.content: Good morning. Which quays can take a vessel of twelve point eight metres draft today?

CALL read_quay Q-01
CALL read_quay Q-02
CALL read_quay Q-03
Book the Northern Gantry on Q-01 from 06:00 to 14:00 tomorrow. I approve the booking.
CALL read_booking BK-4402
TOOL RESULT create_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4404", "vesselCode": "VS-1002", "quayCode": "Q-01", "startHour": 6, "endHour": 14, "status": "confirmed" }
BK-4404 is confirmed for Northern Gantry (VS-1002) on Q-01 from 06:00 to 14:00.
What does an hour on a berth cost?
An hour on a berth costs 46 EUR.
Move that booking to start at 08:00 instead. I approve the amendment.
CALL amend_booking BK-4404 8 14
TOOL RESULT amend_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4404", "startHour": 8, "endHour": 14 }
BK-4404 is confirmed for Northern Gantry (VS-1002) on Q-01 from 08:00 to 14:00.
Is the Salt Harrier cleared to come alongside?

Salt Harrier (VS-1003) is not cleared to come alongside. Its clearance status is "held".

I hand this question to the customs desk by name.
Cancel BK-4403 please. I approve the cancellation.
CALL cancel_booking BK-4403 "Operator request"
TOOL RESULT cancel_booking → { "bookingCode": "BK-4403", "feeApplied": 0 }
BK-4403 is cancelled. No fee was applied.
How long is the waitlist on Q-02?
CALL read_waitlist Q-02 2026-09-14
Summarise for me what is booked on Q-01 today.
CALL list_bookings_for_quay Q-01 2026-09-14
